coding.note: Claims are restricted to the abstract/introduction: the model introduction and three methodological contributions. Curriculum evidence is PARTIAL because comparison with GLM-4.5-Base changes model, data and token budget and does not isolate the curriculum. Comparator evaluation provenance and independent training seeds are not stated. Data categories and volumes are disclosed, but reconstructible source mixtures are not. Compute is coded N conservatively: 480 B200 GPUs and a three-month target are given, not an actual training duration, GPU-hours or FLOPs. No explicit renaming of an acknowledged existing technique was identified; similarity to PRIME-RL alone is insufficient.
